dimensions.label: Retry Until Success
dimensions.description: retry_call returns the first successful result and retries only retryable failures
dimensions.pass_if: success-first, success-after-3 and predicate-retry cases in tests/check.sh pass

dimensions.label: Exponential Backoff
dimensions.description: retries wait base_delay * backoff**(n-1); jitter never negative
dimensions.pass_if: timing test observes >= base_delay + base_delay*backoff elapsed before attempt 3

dimensions.label: Failure Honesty
dimensions.description: raises the LAST exception after attempts; never returns None on failure
dimensions.pass_if: raises-after-attempts and non-retryable-immediate tests raise the expected exception

dimensions.label: Input Validation
dimensions.description: attempts < 1 and negative delays rejected with ValueError

dimensions.label: Style & Minimality
dimensions.pass_if: uses only random + time + stdlib; no third-party deps
